services.label: Full cleaning services
services.description: Includes All Services Below

services.label: High dust
services.description: Dust vents, ceiling fans if present, ledges, tops of partitions, corners, light covers, and other high areas first so dirt falls before lower cleaning starts.

services.label: Empty trash
services.description: Replace liners if dirty, torn, wet, or more than half full.

services.label: Empty and clean feminine hygiene receptacles
services.description: Empty liners, replace bags, wipe covers, handles, and sides, and leave each receptacle clean and closed.

services.label: Refill and wipe down dispensers
services.description: Check toilet paper, paper towels, soap, sanitizer, and other dispensers. Wipe the outside, push buttons, levers, pull areas, and any drips or buildup.

services.label: Clean mirrors and sinks
services.description: Clean mirrors, faucets, sink bowls, counters, splash areas, and soap buildup.

services.label: Clean toilets and urinals
services.description: Cleaning the toilet means the entire toilet: seat, lid, bowl, rim, outside, back of toilet, toilet base, plumbing pipes, flush handles, and flush mechanisms.

services.label: Clean baby changing stations
services.description: Fold the station down and clean the inside, outside, handles, straps, hinges, and wall area around it. Close the station when finished.

services.label: Clean partitions, walls, and doors
services.description: Wipe fingerprints, splashes, handles, locks, push plates, kick plates, and any visible marks.

services.label: Sweep the floor
services.description: Get behind toilets, under dispensers, corners, edges, and around trash cans.

services.label: Mopped
services.description: Always use clean mop water, especially for the final mopping. Wring the mop out well and leave no standing water.

services.label: Final check
services.description: Restroom should look clean, smell clean, be stocked, and have no trash, streaks, puddles, or missed spots.

services.label: Full cleaning services
services.description: Includes All Services Below

services.label: High dust
services.description: Dust ceilings, ceiling fans, vents, corners, beams, ledges, cobwebs, and other high areas first so dirt falls before lower cleaning starts.

services.label: Clean light fixtures
services.description: Dust or wipe fixture covers, bulbs, tracks, and nearby ceiling areas. Report broken lights or unsafe fixtures.

services.label: Clean walls
services.description: Wipe fingerprints, smudges, splashes, dust, cobwebs, and visible marks. Start high and work down.

services.label: Clean doors
services.description: Clean handles, push plates, edges, kick plates, frames, hinges, and any glass in the door.

services.label: Clean outside glass
services.description: Clean viewing glass, windows, frames, edges, fingerprints, water spots, and streaks. Make sure the final glass is clear.

services.label: Remove debris
services.description: Pick up trash, leaves, dust piles, dead bugs, cobwebs, loose dirt, and anything that does not belong.

services.label: Sweep or vacuum the area
services.description: Get corners, edges, under displays, around doors, and along walls.

services.label: Mopped
services.description: Always use clean mop water, especially for the final mopping. Wring the mop out well and leave no standing water.

services.label: Final check
services.description: Area should look clean from guest view: no cobwebs, dust, streaks, fingerprints, trash, puddles, or obvious missed spots.
